sentences.en: Welcome back to my slow English podcast a podcast for English listening for beginners.
sentences.tc: 歡迎回到我的慢速英語播客，這是一​​個針對初學者英語聽力的播客。

sentences.en: Today I will talk about languages I speak two languages English and Spanish when speaking.
sentences.tc: 今天我將談論語言我在演講時會說兩種語言英語和西班牙語。

sentences.en: I feel almost like I have two separate personalities one in English and one in Spanish the distinction between each language is not just the way.
sentences.tc: 我覺得我幾乎有兩種不同的性格，一種是英語，一種是西班牙語，每種語言之間的差異不僅僅是方式。

sentences.en: I am much louder in English than.

sentences.en: I am in Spanish however in Spanish I have a much more outgoing personality it's weird how a language can change your personality English is my.
sentences.tc: 我說西班牙語，但在西班牙語中，我的個性比較外向，奇怪的是，語言如何改變你的性格，英語是我的。

sentences.tc: 我教英語，但當我說西班牙語時，我只在學校或與朋友說過。

sentences.en: Today I only ever speak English with my friends I believe that's why I have a lot more casual vocabulary in Spanish than.
sentences.tc: 今天我只和我的朋友說英語，我相信這就是為什麼我的西班牙語詞彙比西班牙語多得多。

sentences.en: I do in English I have a lot more laidback Spanish.
sentences.tc: 我用英語，但我有更悠閒的西班牙語。

sentences.en: Then English at least that's why I think I have two different personalities in each language what about you.
sentences.tc: 然後是英語，至少這就是為什麼我認為每種語言我都有兩種不同的性格，那麼你呢？
